items.rationale: 10/0 is a divide-by-zero error, so IFERROR returns its second argument, the text n/a.
180 divided by 240 is 0.75. The division works, so there is no error and IFERROR returns the first argument: 0.75.
120/4 is 30 with no error, so IFERROR returns 30. The fallback is used only when the first argument is an error.
A clear message tells the reader that the figure cannot be calculated. 0 looks like a real 0% sell-through, an empty text hides the problem, and 1 invents a result that is false.
